solutions.title: Prefix and suffix products
solutions.notes: Two passes, O(1) extra besides output
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Fill left-products, then multiply running right-products while scanning from the end.

**Example walkthrough:** Left pass puts `[1,1,2,6]`. Right pass multiplies `4,3,2,1` style factors to get `[24,12,8,6]`.
